name: Pentose Phosphate Pathway (PPP)
description: The pentose phosphate pathway generates NADPH for biosynthesis and ribose-5-phosphate for nucleotide synthesis. It has oxidative (G6P → Ru5P + 2 NADPH + CO2) and non-oxidative (reversible sugar interconversions) phases. The pathway branches from glycolysis at glucose-6-phosphate. Zwf (G6P dehydrogenase) is rate-limiting and regulated by NADPH/NADP+ ratio. Transketolase and transaldolase rearrange sugars. The pathway is essential for redox balance, nucleotide synthesis, and aromatic amino acid biosynthesis.
scientificAccuracy: Based on biochemical characterization of E. coli PPP enzymes and regulation.
